annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 152/1
annotation.summary_en: EU Delegated Regulation 2019/945 sets design, manufacture and market-placement requirements for unmanned aircraft systems (drones) in the 'open' category, with classes C0–C4, CE marking, class labels and remote identification. It also sets certification triggers for higher-risk UAS and rules for third-country operators.
key_provisions_or_claims: Class C0–C4 technical requirements for open-category UAS (mass, speed, height limits, geo-awareness, remote ID, noise)
Manufacturer, importer and distributor obligations, CE marking and EU declaration of conformity
Notified body requirements and conformity assessment modules
Mandatory certification for UAS carrying people, dangerous goods, or over 3 m over assemblies of people
Third-country UAS operators must comply with Implementing Regulation 2019/947 in EU airspace
